caveats: Composition of unemployed people is not the unemployment rate of an age/education group.
Public/private employees are components of Employee; totals and subtotals overlap. Rounded totals can be 100.1%. Selected historical tables, not every survey table.

High-CV asterisks are retained where extractable. Other editions use shaded cells; those flags are not fully transcribed, and a null flag does not establish reliability. Ambiguous printed quarters are excluded from latest-series selection.
